@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: A working folder for each run, with the agent folder as the default (D61)
+---
+## Why
+
+Decision D61 of the SwissArmyHammer app: a session is an agent plus a working folder. Any agent can work in any folder. When the user selects no folder, the session works in the folder of the agent itself.
+
+## Problem in the current code
+
+`AgentEnvironment.workingDirectory` is one value for each run of the environment (`AgentEnvironment.swift:82`). `AgentSessionMaker` uses it for the session and for `AgentsMd.documents(from:)` (`AgentSessionMaker.swift:70`, `:93`). A run cannot have its own folder.
+
+## Plan
+
+1. Add an optional working folder to the start of a run (the host API and, if the design session agrees, the `start agent` operation).
+2. The order of the value: the folder of the start request, then `AgentDefinition.folderURL` if the host selects this default, then `environment.workingDirectory`. Find out with the app session if the agent folder default is for each agent or only for agents of the agent-folder source.
+3. The `AGENTS.md` documents come from the working folder of the run.
+4. A child run gets the folder of its parent unless the start request gives a different folder.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- Tests: a run with its own folder, the default from the agent folder, a child run that gets the folder of its parent.
+- Current API and tests keep working. #feature
\ No newline at end of file
